# Fallen Angel Stock Watchlist

Report 189 | Published 2026-05-24 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2026-5-24/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/189.json)

Three watch-list businesses and an affiliated venture.

The clearest miss is the Sprouts bottom: later prices undercut February substantially. AWK subsequently appreciated, but the report remained a watch list and cannot claim an executed gain. Lululemon’s problems persisted. The Orange Juice section is an affiliated investment promotion with an unproven operating record, and is treated accordingly.

**Coverage:** Full numbered text and image inventory read. All material theses across macro, digital assets, investment analysis and concluding sections considered. Position listings and incidental descriptive statistics are excluded unless they support a thesis.

### 189-C10

**Buybacks increase ownership per remaining share.**

| Field | Assessment |
| --- | --- |
| Verdict | Right |
| Type | explanation |
| Horizon | Not specified |
| Conditions | Not specified |
| Author modality | asserted |
| Asset or variable | buyback-per-share-accounting |
| Source blocks | 69 |
| Thesis family | buyback-per-share-accounting |

If net share count falls, each remaining share represents a larger fraction of the company. EPS rises mechanically only holding aggregate earnings constant, and value creation additionally depends on the repurchase price.

**Direction:** See assessment; evidence is limited to the stated proposition.

**Timing:** No fixed deadline stated.

**Mechanism:** Price direction alone does not identify causation.

**Reviewer confidence:** medium

**Deductive assessment:**

- Net shares decline after dilution
- Aggregate earnings held constant

Ownership fraction equals one divided by shares outstanding; EPS equals earnings divided by that same share count.

**Outcome evidence:**

No independent outcome source is recorded. Any deductive assessment is identified separately.

## Framework lessons

- Inspect liabilities and governance behind apparent cheapness.

## Verification limitations

- Current page snapshot is not an authenticated publication-date version.
- A missing horizon is not replaced with an invented author deadline.
- Market sensitivities use vendor adjusted closes and do not reconstruct portfolio execution.
- The author discloses her general-partner role in the venture group launching Orange Juice. No private offering materials or audited venture returns were supplied.
